Reject a wrong argument count or an unknown table with exit 2.\n2. Read the file. An unreadable file exits 1.\n3. Require the header `account,name`; any other header exits 3.\n4. csv.writer(fh, lineterminator=\"\\n\")\n        w.writerow([\"account\", \"name\"])\n        w.writerows(rows)\n    with db_session() as db:\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"accounts\", path)\n        print(out)\n        print(err)\n        assert code == 0\n        parsed = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n        assert parsed == [[\"table\", \"loaded\"], ===\n=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-LoadTransactions.md ===\n# FEATURE: Load Transactions\n\n| Field       | Value |\n|-------------|-------|\n| Version     | 20261025 V1 |\n| Description | Implements `ledger load transactions <csv>` keeping file txn_ids, with all-or-nothing validation and balance checking. |\n| Depends On  | ARCHITECTURE.md, DATABASE.md, FEATURE-CliFoundation.md, FEATURE-BalanceRules.md, FEATURE-LoadAccounts.md, FEATURE-LoadCategories.md |\n| Provides    | ledger load transactions |\n| Consumes    | transactions.create, transactions.get, accounts.get, categories.get, check_balances |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nBulk-load transactions from a CSV file whose header is exactly\n`txn_id,date,account,category,amount,memo`. Each loaded row keeps the `txn_id` from its file. The\ncommand checks every row and the resulting balances before its first write.\n\n## Trigger\n\n`./ledger load transactions <csv>`\n\n## Sequence\n\n1. Reject a wrong argument count with exit 2.\n2. Read the file. An unreadable file exits 1.\n3. Require the exact header; any other header exits 3.\n4. Validate every row: `txn_id` is an integer; the date is a real calendar date `YYYY-MM-DD`; the\n   amount matches `-?DIGITS[.D[D]]`, has at most two decimals, and is never zero; the memo is 0 to\n   60 characters with no comma or newline. Amounts are parsed to integer cents without floating point.\n5. Reject (exit 3) a `txn_id` repeated within the file or already stored, an account absent from\n   `accounts`, and a category absent from `categories`.\n6. Apply the whole file to the stored balances through `check_balances`; if any account balance\n   would be below zero after the file is applied, exit 3 (Decision Q-004: final balances are checked).\n7. Only then write all rows through `transactions.create`, keeping each file `txn_id`.\n8. Print `table,loaded` and `transactions,<rows>`.\n\nA failing command writes nothing to standard output and one diagnostic line to standard error.\n\n## Reads\n\n- `transactions.get`, `accounts.get`, `categories.get` for validation; stored transactions via `check_balances`.\n\n## Writes\n\n- `transactions.create` once per validated row, after all validation has passed.\n\n## Database Purpose\n\nReport each account's transaction count and balance, computed from stored rows in integer cents.\n\n## Trigger\n\n`./ledger report balances`\n\n## Sequence\n\n1. List accounts through `accounts.list` (ordered by code).\n2. For each account compute the transaction count and the balance (sum of amounts, in cents) from\n   `transactions.list` via `account_summary`.\n3. Print the header `account,name,transactions,balance`, one row per account ordered by code, then\n   `TOTAL,,<count>,<sum>` where count and sum cover every account.\n4. Amounts print with exactly two decimal places, a leading `-` when negative, and no thousands separator.\n5. Any argument beyond `balances` is a usage error (exit 2).\n\n## Reads\n\n- `accounts.list`, `transactions.list`.\n\n## Writes\n\n- None.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-ACCOUNTS-003` — read: list accounts in code order - supplies: `account` - returns: `account`, `name`\n- `FEATURE-TRANSACTIONS-003` — read: list transactions for an account - supplies: `account` - returns: `txn_id`, `account`, `amount`\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC report-balances-rows ===\nIntent: The report shows each created account's transaction count and balance in two-decimal form, with zero for an account without transactions.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport re\nfrom decimal import Decimal\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ndef to_cents(text):\n    assert re.fullmatch(r\"-?\\d+\\.\\d{2}\", text)\n    return int(Decimal(text) * 100)\n\nfunded = \"UTRB1\"\nempty = \"UTRB2\"\ncat = \"UTRBC\"\namounts = [100000, -30050, 1999]\nexpected_balance = sum(amounts)\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=funded, name=\"Funded\")\n    db.accounts.create(account=empty, name=\"Empty\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Bal\")\n    for offset, cents in enumerate(amounts):\n        db.transactions.create(\n            txn_id=920001 + offset, date=\"2026-05-01\", account=funded,\n            category=cat, amount=cents, memo=\"\",\n        )\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"report\", \"balances\")\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    assert rows[0] == [\"account\", \"name\", \"transactions\", \"balance\"]\n    by_code = {r[0]: r for r in rows[1:]}\n    assert by_code[funded][1] == \"Funded\"\n    assert int(by_code[funded][2]) == len(amounts)\n    assert to_cents(by_code[funded][3]) == expected_balance\n    assert by_code[empty][1] == \"Empty\"\n    assert int(by_code[empty][2]) == 0\n    assert to_cents(by_code[empty][3]) == 0\n=== END AC report-balances-rows ===\n\n=== AC report-balances-order-and-total ===\nIntent: Account rows are ordered by code and the TOTAL row equals the sum of the account rows' counts and balances.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport re\nfrom decimal import Decimal\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ndef to_cents(text):\n    assert re.fullmatch(r\"-?\\d+\\.\\d{2}\", text)\n    return int(Decimal(text) * 100)\n\nlate = \"UTRC9\"\nearly = \"UTRC1\"\ncat = \"UTRCC\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=late, name=\"Late\")\n    db.accounts.create(account=early, name=\"Early\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Bal\")\n    db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=920101, date=\"2026-05-01\", account=late, category=cat, amount=2500, memo=\"\"\n    )\n    db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=920102, date=\"2026-05-01\", account=early, category=cat, amount=700, memo=\"\"\n    )\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"report\", \"balances\")\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert codes.index(late)\n    total = rows[-1]\n    assert total[0] == \"TOTAL\"\n    assert total[1] == \"\"\n    assert int(total[2]) == sum(int(r[2]) for r in data)\n    assert to_cents(total[3]) == sum(to_cents(r[3]) for r in data)\n    stored_count = len(db.transactions.list())\n    assert int(total[2]) == stored_count\n=== END AC report-balances-order-and-total ===\n\n=== AC report-balances-reflects-changes ===\nIntent: The report is recomputed from stored rows, so a later transaction changes the balance by exactly its amount.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport re\nfrom decimal import Decimal\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ndef to_cents(text):\n    assert re.fullmatch(r\"-?\\d+\\.\\d{2}\", text)\n    return err = cli_runner(\"report\", \"nosuchreport\")\n    assert code == 2 and out == \"\"\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"report\")\n    assert code == 2 and out == \"\"\n=== END AC FEATURE-ReportCategories.md ===\n# FEATURE: Report Categories\n\n| Field       | Value |\n|-------------|-------|\n| Version     | 20261025 V1 |\n| Description | Implements `ledger report categories`, the per-category inflow, outflow, and net with a TOTAL row. |\n| Depends On  | ARCHITECTURE.md, DATABASE.md, FEATURE-CliFoundation.md |\n| Provides    | ledger report categories |\n| Consumes    | categories.list, transactions.list |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nReport totals by category, computed from stored rows in integer cents, including categories that\nhave no transactions.\n\n## Trigger\n\n`./ledger report categories`\n\n## Sequence\n\n1. List categories through `categories.list` (ordered by code) and all transactions through `transactions.list`.\n2. For each category compute the transaction count, `inflow` (sum of positive amounts), `outflow`\n   (sum of absolute values of negative amounts, printed as a positive number), and `net`\n   (`inflow - outflow`).\n3. Print the header `category,description,transactions,inflow,outflow,net`, one row per category\n   ordered by code (empty categories print `0` and `0.00` values), then\n   `TOTAL,,<count>,<inflow>,<outflow>,<net>` over all categories.\n4. Amounts print with exactly two decimal places, a leading `-` when negative, and no thousands separator.\n5. Any argument beyond `categories` is a usage error (exit 2).\n\n## Reads\n\n- `categories.list`, `transactions.list`.\n\n## Writes\n\n- None.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-CATEGORIES-003` — read: list categories in code order - supplies: `category` - returns: `category`, `description`\n- `FEATURE-TRANSACTIONS-003` — read: list every transaction - supplies: `account` - returns: `txn_id`, `category`, `amount`\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC report-categories-row-values ===\nIntent: A category's count, inflow, outflow, and net match the cents of the transactions created for it, and an empty category reports zeros.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport re\nfrom decimal import Decimal\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ndef to_cents(text):\n    assert re.fullmatch(r\"-?\\d+\\.\\d{2}\", text)\n    return int(Decimal(text) * 100)\n\nacct = \"UTSA1\"\nused = \"UTSC1\"\nunused = \"UTSC2\"\namounts = [50000, 1999, -1250, -75]\ninflow = sum(a for a in amounts if a > 0)\noutflow = sum(-a for a in amounts if a < 0)\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Cats\")\n    db.categories.create(category=used, description=\"Used\")\n    db.categories.create(category=unused, description=\"Unused\")\n    for offset, cents in enumerate(amounts):\n        db.transactions.create(\n            txn_id=930001 + offset, date=\"2026-05-01\", account=acct,\n            category=used, amount=cents, memo=\"\",\n        )\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"report\", \"categories\")\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    assert rows[0] == [\"category\", \"description\", \"transactions\", \"inflow\", \"outflow\", \"net\"]\n    by_code = {r[0]: r for r in rows[1:]}\n    row = by_code[used]\n    assert row[1] == \"Used\"\n    assert int(row[2]) == len(amounts)\n    assert to_cents(row[3]) == inflow\n    assert to_cents(row[4]) == outflow\n    assert to_cents(row[5]) == inflow - load-categories-header-and-usage ===\n\n## User Acceptance\n\n- None.\n\n## Guardrails\n\n- Validate every row and rule before the first write; a rejected load changes nothing.\n- Do not read ===\n=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-LoadTransactions.md ===\n# FEATURE: Load Transactions\n\n| Field       | Value |\n|-------------|-------|\n| Version     | 20261025 V1 |\n| Description | Implements `ledger load transactions <csv>` keeping file txn_ids, with all-or-nothing validation and balance checking. |\n| Depends On  | ARCHITECTURE.md, DATABASE.md, FEATURE-CliFoundation.md, FEATURE-BalanceRules.md, FEATURE-LoadAccounts.md, FEATURE-LoadCategories.md |\n| Provides    | ledger load transactions |\n| Consumes    | transactions.create, transactions.get, accounts.get, categories.get, check_balances |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nBulk-load transactions from a CSV file whose header is exactly\n`txn_id,date,account,category,amount,memo`. Each loaded row keeps the `txn_id` from its file. The\ncommand checks every row and the resulting balances before its first write.\n\n## Trigger\n\n`./ledger load transactions <csv>`\n\n## Sequence\n\n1. Reject a wrong argument count with exit 2.\n2. Read the file. An unreadable file exits 1.\n3. Require the exact header; any other header exits 3.\n4. Validate every row: `txn_id` is an integer; the date is a real calendar date `YYYY-MM-DD`; the\n   amount matches `-?DIGITS[.D[D]]`, has at most two decimals, and is never zero; the memo is 0 to\n   60 characters with no comma or newline. Amounts are parsed to integer cents without floating point.\n5. Reject (exit 3) a `txn_id` repeated within the file or already stored, an account absent from\n   `accounts`, and a category absent from `categories`.\n6. Apply the whole file to the stored balances through `check_balances`; if any account balance\n   would be below zero after the file is applied, exit 3 (Decision Q-004: final balances are checked).\n7. Only then write all rows through `transactions.create`, keeping each file `txn_id`.\n8. Print `table,loaded` and `transactions,<rows>`.\n\nA failing command writes nothing to standard output and one diagnostic line to standard error.\n\n## Reads\n\n- `transactions.get`, `accounts.get`, `categories.get` for validation; stored transactions via `check_balances`.\n\n## Writes\n\n- `transactions.create` once per validated row, after all validation has passed.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-TRANSACTIONS-001` — write: create a transaction - supplies: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo` - returns: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo`\n- `FEATURE-TRANSACTIONS-002` — read: find a stored transaction by id - supplies: `txn_id` - returns: `txn_id`, `account`, `amount`\n- `FEATURE-ACCOUNTS-002` — read: find a stored account by code - supplies: `account` - returns: `account`\n- `FEATURE-CATEGORIES-002` — read: find a stored category by code - supplies: `category` - returns: `category`\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC load-transactions-valid ===\nIntent: A valid transactions file keeps its txn_ids, stores integer cents, and reports the loaded count.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ndef dollars(c):\n    return (\"-\" if c < 0 else \"\") + str(abs(c) // 100) + \".\" + format(abs(c) % 100, \"02d\")\n\nacct = \"UTMA1\"\ncat = \"UTMC1\"\nrows = [\n    (910001, \"2026-05-01\", 10000, \"opening\"),\n    (910002, \"2026-05-02\", -2550, \"spend\"),\n    (910007, \"2026-05-03\", 475, \"gap id kept\"),\n]\nwith tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:\n    path = os.path.join(tmp, \"txns.csv\")\n    with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as fh:\n        w = csv.writer(fh, lineterminator=\"\\n\")\n        w.writerow([\"txn_id\", \"date\", \"account\", \"category\", \"amount\", \"memo\"])\n        for txn_id, when, cents, memo in rows:\n            w.writerow([txn_id, when, acct, cat, dollars(cents), memo])\n    with db_session() as db:\n        db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Load Txn\")\n        db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Load Txn\")\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"transactions\", path)\n        print(out)\n        print(err)\n        assert code == 0\n        parsed = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n  assert stored is not None\n            assert stored.date == when\n            assert stored.account == acct\n            assert stored.category == cat\n            assert stored.amount == cents\n            assert isinstance(stored.amount, int)\n            assert stored.memo == memo\n=== END AC load-transactions-valid ===\n\n=== AC load-transactions-unknown-references ===\nIntent: An unknown FEATURE-CliFoundation.md, FEATURE-BalanceRules.md |\n| Provides    | ledger report balances |\n| Consumes    | accounts.list, transactions.list, account_summary |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nReport each account's transaction count and balance, computed from stored rows in integer cents.\n\n## Trigger\n\n`./ledger report balances`\n\n## Sequence\n\n1. List accounts through `accounts.list` (ordered by code).\n2. For each account compute the transaction count and the balance (sum of amounts, in cents) from\n   `transactions.list` via `account_summary`.\n3. Print the header `account,name,transactions,balance`, one row per account ordered by code, then\n   `TOTAL,,<count>,<sum>` where count and sum cover every account.\n4. Amounts print with exactly two decimal places, a leading `-` when negative, and no thousands separator.\n5. Any argument beyond `balances` is a usage error (exit 2).\n\n## Reads\n\n- `accounts.list`, `transactions.list`.\n\n## Writes\n\n- None.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-ACCOUNTS-003` — read: list accounts in code order - supplies: `account` - returns: `account`, `name`\n- `FEATURE-TRANSACTIONS-003` — read: list transactions for an account - supplies: `account` - returns: `txn_id`, `account`, `amount`\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC report-balances-rows ===\nIntent: The report shows each created account's transaction count and balance in two-decimal form, with zero for an account without transactions.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport re\nfrom decimal import Decimal\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ndef to_cents(text):\n    assert re.fullmatch(r\"-?\\d+\\.\\d{2}\", text)\n    return int(Decimal(text) * 100)\n\nfunded = \"UTRB1\"\nempty = \"UTRB2\"\ncat = \"UTRBC\"\namounts = [100000, -30050, 1999]\nexpected_balance = sum(amounts)\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=funded, name=\"Funded\")\n    db.accounts.create(account=empty, name=\"Empty\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Bal\")\n    for offset, cents in enumerate(amounts):\n        db.transactions.create(\n            txn_id=920001 + offset, date=\"2026-05-01\", account=funded,\n            category=cat, amount=cents, memo=\"\",\n        )\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"report\", \"balances\")\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    assert rows[0] == [\"account\", \"name\", \"transactions\", \"balance\"]\n    by_code = {r[0]: r for r in rows[1:]}\n    assert by_code[funded][1] == \"Funded\"\n    assert int(by_code[funded][2]) == len(amounts)\n    assert to_cents(by_code[funded][3]) == expected_balance\n    assert by_code[empty][1] == \"Empty\"\n    assert int(by_code[empty][2]) == 0\n    assert to_cents(by_code[empty][3]) == 0\n=== END AC report-balances-rows ===\n\n=== AC report-balances-order-and-total ===\nIntent: Account rows are ordered by code and the TOTAL row equals the sum of the account rows' counts and balances.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport re\nfrom decimal import Decimal\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ndef to_cents(text):\n    assert re.fullmatch(r\"-?\\d+\\.\\d{2}\", text)\n    return int(Decimal(text) * 100)\n\nlate = \"UTRC9\"\nearly = \"UTRC1\"\ncat = \"UTRCC\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=late, name=\"Late\")\n    db.accounts.create(account=early, name=\"Early\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Bal\")\n    db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=920101, date=\"2026-05-01\", account=late, category=cat, amount=2500, memo=\"\"\n    )\n    db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=920102, date=\"2026-05-01\", account=early, category=cat, amount=700, memo=\"\"\n    )\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"report\", \"balances\")\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    data = rows[1:-1]\n    codes = [r[0] for r in data]\n    assert codes == sorted(codes)\n    assert codes.index(early) < codes.index(late)\n    total = rows[-1]\n    assert total[0] == \"TOTAL\"\n    assert total[1] == \"\"\n    assert int(total[2]) == sum(int(r[2]) for r in data)\n    assert to_cents(total[3]) == sum(to_cents(r[3]) for r in data)\n    stored_count = len(db.transactions.list())\n    assert int(total[2]) == stored_count\n=== END AC report-balances-order-and-total ===\n\n=== AC report-balances-reflects-changes ===\nIntent: The report is recomputed from stored rows, so a later transaction changes the balance by exactly its amount.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport re\nfrom decimal import Decimal\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ndef to_cents(text):\n    assert re.fullmatch(r\"-?\\d+\\.\\d{2}\", text)\n    return int(Decimal(text) * 100)\n\ndef balance_of(out, account):\n    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    return {r[0]: r for r in rows[1:]}[account]\n\nacct = \"UTRD1\"\ncat = \"UTRDC\"\nfirst = 8000\nsecond = 1234\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Moves\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Bal\")\n    db.transactions.create(\n report-balances-reflects-changes ===\n\n=== AC report-balances-usage ===\nIntent: An extra argument after balances and an unknown report each exit 2 with nothing on stdout.\n\nfrom cli.testing import err = cli_runner(\"report\", \"nosuchreport\")\n    assert code == 2 and out == \"\"\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"report\")\n    assert code == 2 and out == \"\"\n=== END AC report-balances-usage ===\n\n## User Acceptance\n\n- None.\n\n## Guardrails\n\n- Every value comes from a query of stored rows; no row, count, or total is hardcoded or stored.\n- Money is integer cents internally; no floating point at any layer.\n- The command writes nothing to the database.\n- Diagnostics go to standard error only.\n=== END ARTIFACT ===\n=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-ReportCategories.md ===\n# FEATURE: Report Categories\n\n| Field       | Value |\n|-------------|-------|\n| Version     | 20261025 V1 |\n| Description | Implements `ledger report categories`, the per-category inflow, outflow, and net with a TOTAL row. |\n| Depends On  | ARCHITECTURE.md, DATABASE.md, FEATURE-CliFoundation.md |\n| Provides    | ledger report categories |\n| Consumes    | categories.list, transactions.list |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nReport totals by category, computed from stored rows in integer cents, including categories that\nhave no transactions.\n\n## Trigger\n\n`./ledger report categories`\n\n## Sequence\n\n1. List categories through `categories.list` (ordered by code) and all transactions through `transactions.list`.\n2. For each category compute the transaction count, `inflow` (sum of positive amounts), `outflow`\n   (sum of absolute values of negative amounts, printed as a positive number), and `net`\n   (`inflow - outflow`).\n3. Print the header `category,description,transactions,inflow,outflow,net`, one row per category\n   ordered by code (empty categories print `0` and `0.00` values), then\n   `TOTAL,,<count>,<inflow>,<outflow>,<net>` over all categories.\n4. Amounts print with exactly two decimal places, a leading `-` when negative, and no thousands separator.\n5. Any argument beyond `categories` is a usage error (exit 2).\n\n## Reads\n\n- `categories.list`, `transactions.list`.\n\n## Writes\n\n- None.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-CATEGORIES-003` — read: list categories in code order - supplies: `category` - returns: `category`, `description`\n- `FEATURE-TRANSACTIONS-003` — read: list every transaction - supplies: `account` - returns: `txn_id`, `category`, `amount`\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC report-categories-row-values ===\nIntent: A category's count, inflow, outflow, and net match the cents of the transactions created for it, and an empty category reports zeros.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport re\nfrom decimal import Decimal\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ndef to_cents(text):\n    assert re.fullmatch(r\"-?\\d+\\.\\d{2}\", text)\n    return int(Decimal(text) * 100)\n\nacct = \"UTSA1\"\nused = \"UTSC1\"\nunused = \"UTSC2\"\namounts = [50000, 1999, -1250, -75]\ninflow = sum(a for a in amounts if a > 0)\noutflow = sum(-a for a in amounts if a < 0)\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Cats\")\n    db.categories.create(category=used, description=\"Used\")\n    db.categories.create(category=unused, description=\"Unused\")\n    for offset, cents in enumerate(amounts):\n        db.transactions.create(\n            txn_id=930001 + offset, date=\"2026-05-01\", account=acct,\n            category=used, amount=cents, memo=\"\",\n        )\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"report\", \"categories\")\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    assert rows[0] == [\"category\", \"description\", \"transactions\", \"inflow\", \"outflow\", \"net\"]\n    by_code = {r[0]: r for r in rows[1:]}\n    row = by_code[used]\n    assert row[1] == \"Used\"\n    assert int(row[2]) == len(amounts)\n    assert to_cents(row[3]) == inflow\n    assert to_cents(row[4]) == outflow\n    assert to_cents(row[5]) == inflow - outflow\n    empty = by_code[unused]\n    assert empty[1] == \"Unused\"\n    assert int(empty[2]) == 0\n    assert to_cents(empty[3]) == 0\n    assert to_cents(empty[4]) == 0\n    assert to_cents(empty[5]) == 0\n=== END AC report-categories-row-values ===\n\n=== AC report-categories-order-and-total ===\nIntent: Category rows are ordered by code and the TOTAL row equals the sums of the category rows and the stored transaction count.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport re\nfrom decimal import Decimal\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ndef to_cents(text):\n    assert re.fullmatch(r\"-?\\d+\\.\\d{2}\", text)\n    return int(Decimal(text) * 100)\n\nacct = \"UTSB1\"\nlate = \"UTSD9\"\nearly = \"UTSD1\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Cats\")\n    db.categories.create(category=late, description=\"Late\")\n    db.categories.create(category=early, description=\"Early\")\n    db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=930101, date=\"2026-05-01\", account=acct, category=late, amount=900, memo=\"\"\n    )\n    db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=930102, date=\"2026-05-02\", account=acct, category=early, amount=-300, memo=\"\"\n    )\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"report\", \"categories\")\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    data = rows[1:-1]\n    codes = [r[0] for r in data]\n    assert codes == sorted(codes)\n    assert codes.index(early) < codes.index(late)\n    total = rows[-1]\n    assert total[0] == \"TOTAL\"\n    assert total[1] == \"\"\n    assert int(total[2]) == sum(int(r[2]) for r in data)\n    assert int(total[2]) == len(db.transactions.list())\n    assert to_cents(total[3]) == sum(to_cents(r[3]) for r in data)\n    assert to_cents(total[4]) == sum(to_cents(r[4]) for r in data)\n    assert to_cents(total[5]) == to_cents(total[3]) - to_cents(total[4])\n=== END AC report-categories-order-and-total ===\n\n=== AC report-categories-reflects-changes ===\nIntent: The report is recomputed from stored rows, so a later outflow raises the category's outflow and lowers its net by exactly its amount.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport re\nfrom decimal import Decimal\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ndef to_cents(text):\n    assert re.fullmatch(r\"-?\\d+\\.\\d{2}\", text)\n    return int(Decimal(text) * 100)\n\ndef row_for(out, category):\n    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    return {r[0]: r for r in rows[1:]}[category]\n\nacct = \"UTSE1\"\ncat = \"UTSEC\"\ndeposit = 7000\nspend = 2345\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Moves\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Moves\")\n    db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=930201, date=\"2026-05-01\", account=acct, category=cat, amount=deposit, memo=\"\"\n    )\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"report\", \"categories\")\n    assert code == 0\n    before = row_for(out, cat)\n    assert to_cents(before[4]) == 0\n    db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=930202, date=\"2026-05-02\", account=acct, category=cat, amount=-spend, memo=\"\"\n    )\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"report\", \"categories\")\n    assert code == 0\n    after = row_for(out, cat)\n    assert int(after[2]) == int(before[2]) + 1\n    assert to_cents(after[3]) == deposit\n    assert to_cents(after[4]) == spend\n    assert to_cents(after[5]) == deposit - spend\n=== END AC report-categories-reflects-changes ===\n\n=== AC report-categories-usage ===\nIntent: An extra argument after categories exits 2 with nothing on stdout.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nwith db_session():\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"report\", \"categories\", \"extra\")\n    assert code == 2 and out == \"\"\n=== END AC report-categories-usage ===\n\n## User Acceptance\n\n- None.\n\n## Guardrails\n\n- Every value comes from a query of stored rows; no row, count, or total is hardcoded or stored.\n- Outflow is printed as a positive number; net is inflow minus outflow.\n- Money is integer cents internally; no floating point at any layer.\n- The command writes nothing to the database.\n- Diagnostics go to standard error only.\n=== END ARTIFACT ===","ttft_ms":29216,"type":"result","duration_ms":109522,"uuid":"237bfd01-41c9-4dff-9e1e-7aca36ccb037","ttft_stream_ms":3504,"time_to_request_ms":234,"first_content_frame_ms":3505,"queued_turn_count":0,"result_index":0,"model_usage_since_last_result":{"claude-sonnet-5-5":{"inputTokens":2,"outputTokens":19633,"cacheReadInputTokens":1568,"cacheCreationInputTokens":91262,"webSearchRequests":0,"costUSD":0.5615388,"contextWindow":1000000,"maxOutputTokens":128000,"thinkingTokens":2992,"canonicalModel":"claude-sonnet-5-5","provider":"firstParty","costBasis":"list"}}}
